turns.question: What can you do?
turns.evidenceNotes: Development fixture. Check that actual offered options are usable; fixture does not supply an assistant answer.

turns.question: The second one, please.
turns.evidenceNotes: The preceding actual capability response must offer fiction second. Review whether this turn follows that offer and remains clearly fictional.

turns.question: Make it more suspenseful; keep the character and setting.
turns.evidenceNotes: Review the actual previous scene and this revision together. Character and setting must remain; suspense should be apparent. Substring checks cannot establish either quality.

turns.question: Give it an open ending and keep the suspenseful tone.
turns.evidenceNotes: Review continuity, open outcome, suspense and concise rendering against the real previous response. Synthetic development case, not held-out or independently reviewed evidence.
